verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to export TOTP secrets in an open, readable format. The 'Export Passwords' feature covers autofill passwords, not OTP secrets. Cloud Backup only restores accounts back into Authenticator on a new device, and saving QR secrets in a password manager before enrolling is a user-side workaround, so none of these earn credit for portability.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in
